price_snapshots.expected_definition: 14 week-10 games x 3 markets (side, total, moneyline) x 2 snapshots (open, close).

props.reason: The odds endpoint carries a propBets sub-resource (count reported by the provider before filtering). It was NOT archived this round because the response is truncated by paging and duplicating rows, so a partial archive would be misleading. Zero prop prices are stored; zero are published as fact.

what_we_do_not_have: Official prices of any kind - the NFL publishes no odds.
Opening lines for week 9 or any week before 10 - the archive covers week 10 only, and that limitation is deliberate.
Player prop prices - present at the provider, not archived, see above.
Pre-game depth state - no official depth chart exists.
Closing lines for 13 of 14 week-10 games - those games have not kicked off, so no close exists yet. Open is not close.
